title: Page 166
transc:
No 10
Gates Columbus O.  Sept 3. 1864 930 PM
Mohawk Sarah for Ashland ---- You
will immedy wick Luther Giddings &
send him under sufficient rodney to
the old Capitol prison in this
City ---- By order of the
Blanchard sig C A Dana Asst
Sec War


No 2
Beckwith City Pt.  Wash. Sept. 3. 1864 930 pm
Rosalie Benton for Interest M.
nuptial Senior Naval Radical Abbot
wafer Brimstone ---- The Onondaga
& Atlanta trifle the only
iron clods retained in Abbot
---- Prepare the Saugus &
Canonicus to go wick ----
Paulding tremendous Saxon Spoon Answer
Benjamin Paulding is arbitrary End
